rules-note: Business strikes only, including the P and D coins the Mint sold only in rolls, bags and boxes: no proofs or reverse proofs, no Special Mint Set, special finish set or other set-only special strikes (Burnished, Enhanced Uncirculated), no silver or bullion strikes. Every coin carries a mint mark (mintMark is never null). variety is the design as displayed in the source, null where one design covers the year; a variety is listed only where the source has a separate row with its own figure, and edge-lettering errors are not varieties. Mintages come only from the saved source, null where it gives no figure; nothing is summed, split or estimated, and totals are ignored. Release order: designs in source order, then the mints. isKeyDate is false throughout because no cited source names key dates; no images. This file: the prose of "Susan B. Anthony dollar" (no mintage table). 1979, 1980 and 1981 P, D, S and 1999 P, D; variety is null throughout. The 1979-1981 coins have null mintage because the source gives only yearly totals, which are never split or assigned to one mint; the 1980 mints come from the infobox (P, D, S), since the prose does not name them. The 1981 coins, issued only to collectors in mint sets, are the year's business strikes and are included. The 1979 "near date" (wide rim) P has no figure of its own and is not a variety. Excluded: every proof (S and the 1999 P proof).
